about: The words the website signs for POST /api/push/subscribe and /api/push/unsubscribe (2026-11-06, BUG-255), Dilithium3 over each preimage; since 2026-11-20 each is a signed request, and since 2026-11-21 one naming its server (hum/request/v2, the audience, the purpose, the time: scripts/tests/fixtures/signed-request-v2.json). The relay's builders (src/relay/push_routes.rs subscribe_purpose, unsubscribe_purpose) are held to it by push_routes_tests.rs, the website's requests (web/chat/chat-ui.js subscribeToPush, web/pages/settings-app.js unsubscribeFromPush) by scripts/tests/push-subscribe-web.test.js. The keys are RFC 8291 appendix A's user agent's.
